info.name: NutriPrep API
info.description:
Full request collection for the NutriPrep REST API.

Run the folders in order (or use Collection Runner): Auth stores `token`, `adminToken` and `userId`; create requests store `categoryId`, `recipeId` and `mealPlanId` for later requests. The admin user comes from `npm run prisma:seed` (ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env).

`2b. OAuth2` covers the OAuth2 token endpoint: password, refresh (rotation), narrow scopes, client credentials and revocation. Set `serviceClientSecret` to your OAUTH_SERVICE_CLIENT_SECRET.

item.name: 2b. OAuth2
item.description: Role-based OAuth2: the user's role decides which scopes a token can carry. Needs the member registered in folder 2 and the seeded OAuth clients (`npm run prisma:seed`). Set `serviceClientSecret` to your OAUTH_SERVICE_CLIENT_SECRET for the client credentials requests.

exec: pm.test("MEMBER role scopes", () => pm.expect(body.scope).to.eql("profile categories:read recipes:read recipes:write mealplans:read mealplans:write"));

item.name: Get Me With OAuth Access Token

exec: pm.test("Client scopes only, no refresh token", () => { pm.expect(body.scope).to.eql("categories:read categories:write"); pm.expect(body).to.not.have.property("refresh_token"); });

exec: pm.test("All recipes belong to the category", () => body.data.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.categoryId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("categoryId")))));

request.description: Recipes in the category with protein at least 25.

exec: pm.test("Every recipe has protein at least 25", () => body.data.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.protein).to.be.at.least(25)));
pm.test("Created recipe (45 g protein, 60 g carbs, 520 kcal, 12 g fat) is included", () => pm.expect(body.data.map((r) => r.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId"))));

request.description: Recipes in the category with carbs at least 50.

exec: pm.test("Every recipe has carbs at least 50", () => body.data.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.carbs).to.be.at.least(50)));
pm.test("Created recipe (45 g protein, 60 g carbs, 520 kcal, 12 g fat) is included", () => pm.expect(body.data.map((r) => r.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId"))));

request.description: Recipes in the category with calories at most 400.

exec: pm.test("Every recipe has calories at most 400", () => body.data.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.calories).to.be.at.most(400)));
pm.test("Created recipe (45 g protein, 60 g carbs, 520 kcal, 12 g fat) is excluded", () => pm.expect(body.data.map((r) => r.id)).to.not.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId"))));

request.description: Recipes in the category with fat at most 10.

exec: pm.test("Every recipe has fat at most 10", () => body.data.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.fat).to.be.at.most(10)));
pm.test("Created recipe (45 g protein, 60 g carbs, 520 kcal, 12 g fat) is excluded", () => pm.expect(body.data.map((r) => r.id)).to.not.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId"))));

request.description: Comma-separated presets are combined with AND.

exec: pm.test("Every recipe matches both presets", () => body.data.forEach((r) => { pm.expect(r.protein).to.be.at.least(25); pm.expect(r.calories).to.be.at.most(400); }));
pm.test("550 kcal recipe is excluded", () => pm.expect(body.data.map((r) => r.id)).to.not.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId"))));
pm.test("Sorted by savedCount", () => body.data.forEach((r, i) => { if (i) pm.expect(r.savedCount).to.be.at.most(body.data[i - 1].savedCount); }));

request.description: Each meal plan entry is one slot: user + day + meal type + recipe. Change the {{day}} collection variable (Monday … Sunday) to plan another day.
All meals planned for the day in the {{day}} variable, Breakfast → Lunch → Dinner.

exec: pm.test("Day has breakfast, lunch and dinner in order", () => pm.expect(body.data.map((p) => p.mealType)).to.eql(["Breakfast", "Lunch", "Dinner"]));
pm.test("Every entry is on the selected day", () => body.data.forEach((p) => pm.expect(p.dayOfWeek).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("day"))));

request.description: The whole week, Monday to Sunday, each day with Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner (null when empty) and daily macro totals.

exec: pm.test("Seven days in calendar order", () => pm.expect(week.days.map((d) => d.dayOfWeek)).to.eql(["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]));

pm.test("Selected day has all three meals", () => { const day = week.days.find((d) => d.dayOfWeek === pm.collectionVariables.get("day")); ["Breakfast", "Lunch", "Dinner"].forEach((m) => pm.expect(day.meals[m]).to.not.be.null); });

request.description: Swaps the recipe of the lunch slot.

exec: pm.test("Shared plan is listed", () => pm.expect(body.data.some((p) => p.owner.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("userId")))).to.eql(true));
